tests.title: Only one of two customers can buy the last unit of a product
tests.goal: The eShop never sells more units than are available, even when two carts hold the last one.
preconditions: A non-quota product whose stock in the warehouse serving Online Shop (TaiPo, see Q-009) is small, found at runtime in CRM Inventory; if none, create it with a transfer of 1 unit to TaiPo (SCRM-028) and note the product (available = 1 for the test)
Two browser sessions: a QA member and a guest (or a second QA member), both carts empty

steps.text: Session A and session B each add 1 unit of the product to the cart -> Expect: both get "Item added successfully"
Both open /checkout and fill the details up to Proceed to checkout
Session A clicks Proceed to checkout
Session B clicks Proceed to checkout
CRM: read the product row in Inventory and the order list

expected.text: Step 3: thank-you page with an order number
Step 4: refused with a message that the product is out of stock / not enough stock; no second order is created
Step 5: exactly one new order; Available for the warehouse is 0, never negative
Cleanup: void the order (stock returns to 1) and empty both carts

notes: One approved concurrent attempt using two isolated Playwright guest contexts. Both orders TXN0126103000007 and TXN0126103000008 succeeded with initial TaiPo Available 1; available became -1. Product Pre-order was disabled. Both orders voided; stock restored to 1. No retry.
